title: REQ · Intro screen is a full-screen backdrop with a centered framed dialog
summary: IntroScreen renders over a full-viewport room background with its text and Begin button inside a centered parchment dialog.
description: Context: IntroScreen.tsx renders four plain paragraphs and a bare button in section.intro-screen with no styling. Desired behavior: full-screen background and a centered framed dialog with a gold Begin button. Expected result: the first screen looks like an indie game title card. Why: first impression and usability.
acceptance_criteria: Given IntroScreen renders, when inspected, then the root has class sf-fullscreen-bg and contains a centered dialog with class sf-frame-parchment.
Given IntroScreen renders, when the Begin button is clicked, then onBegin is called once and the four intro lines are still present.
technical_constraints: Use existing wall.png under /assets/worlds/the-boys-room/room as the backdrop
Use Frame and Button components from components/ui
definition_of_done: IntroScreen shows a backdrop and centered dialog and its unit test passes
